findings: Two figures are printed as Figure 15.5 (generation and propagation of the action potential).
The peak of the action potential is printed as +50 mV; many textbooks give about +30 to +40 mV. The lesson and the original graph carry +50 mV as printed and note the difference, flagged.
The book places the refractory period in the hyperpolarization; the absolute refractory period covers depolarization and early repolarization. Noted in the lesson, flagged.
